This is a senior-level backend software engineering role on Coinbase's institutional financing team, working on the lending and credit systems behind its crypto brokerage for institutional clients. The work covers services and APIs for loan lifecycle management, risk calculation, and real-time position tracking across products like portfolio margin, trade finance, and agency lending. The core stack is Go or Java in a cloud-native, service-oriented environment, with gRPC/Protobuf, relational databases, and distributed systems where correctness and data integrity matter.
